text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, the final race of the 
Classics. The victor was neither Cheval 
Grand nor Kitasan Black, but another 
Umamusume entirely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Kitasan Black runs over to 
Cheval Grand. Amidst the cheers, she 
shares both her frustration and the 
exhilarating feeling of having given it 
everything they had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from giving her all in the 
Kikuka Sho, Cheval Grand opens up about 
what's in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black was similar to herself; she 
had never stood out and had harbored 
feelings of inferiority, yet she faced her 
weaknesses and overcame them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—She wanted to believe that she, too, 
possessed a strength unique to her own 
self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand began looking beyond her 
immediate surroundings. Setting her sights 
on future showdowns with Kitasan Black, 
she resolved to devote herself to 
training.
